subsystems.value: Time Projection Chamber (TPC): the central tracking detector, 4 m diameter x 4.2 m long, providing complete azimuthal charged-particle tracking within about |η| < 1.8

summary.plain: A house-sized detector built around a giant gas-filled chamber that photographs the tracks of thousands of particles flying out of each collision at RHIC.
summary.technical: STAR: a 1,200 t heavy-ion collider detector at RHIC IP6, built around a 4 m diameter x 4.2 m long gaseous Time Projection Chamber inside a solenoidal magnet, providing full-azimuth charged-particle tracking within |η| < 1.8.

technology.quote: The TPC is the central element in a suite of detectors that surrounds the interaction vertex. The TPC provides complete coverage around the beam-line ... It sits in a large solenoidal magnet that operates at 0.5 T
technology.value: Large-acceptance gaseous Time Projection Chamber surrounded by a solenoidal magnet, with additional trigger, particle-identification and event-characterization detectors
